messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up: Orion Financial returned the SIG v2 and flagged Q21-Q24 as gating. They want per-question artifacts + short plain-English answers. Can we triage?

dan_se: I can take Q21 (multi-tenant isolation) and Q24 (network segregation). Need the latest tenancy diagram and a sanitized envoy example.

oliver_security: I'll own Q22 (KMS/key lifecycle) and Q23 (data encryption rest/in-transit). I have a cert excerpt and a key-rotation snippet to reference.

jana_ps: I'll pull SOC2 snippets, the dataflow narrative, and a short test-run screenshot from our POC infra to attach.

filesbot: File uploaded: <https://files.redwood.internal/tenancy_diagram_2026.pdf|tenancy_diagram_2026.pdf> (450KB)

dan_se: Thanks. Quick question — Orion asked for a sample tenant ACL manifest. Want an HCL snippet or YAML?

maria_sales: They said YAML in the questionnaire example. Keep it redacted. Also they asked whether cache keys are logically separated per-tenant.

dan_se: Will include a sanitized YAML and a 1-line note about KV namespace isolation. Example I'll paste here (sanitized):
```yaml
# per-tenant cache namespace (sanitized)
cache_namespaces:
  - tenant: orion-demo
    namespace: rwinf_cache_orion_demo
```

oliver_security: For KMS: reference our HSM-backed provider integration and the rotation cadence. I'll attach `kms-rotation-summary.md` with policy excerpt. Also add BYOK note: supported for Private deployments with customer-managed key import via KMS APIs.

jana_ps: Uploaded SOC2 excerpt + dataflow: <https://files.redwood.internal/soc2_excert_orion.pdf|soc2_excert_orion.pdf>, <https://files.redwood.internal/dataflow_orion.md|dataflow_orion.md>

filesbot: File uploaded: <https://files.redwood.internal/poc_screenshot_orion.png|poc_screenshot_orion.png> (128KB)

maria_sales: Can each of you paste the final filenames for the bundle and a 1-2 sentence plain-English blurb we can paste into the SIG answers (non-technical reviewers)? I'll assemble and run quick redaction.

dan_se: Filenames: `/shared/sales-orion/tenancy_diagram_redacted.pdf`, `/shared/sales-orion/envoy_tenant_sample.yaml`

dan_se: Plain English: "Requests for each tenant are routed to separate proxy routes which map to isolated runtime clusters and distinct cache namespaces to prevent cross-tenant access."

oliver_security: Filenames: `/shared/sales-orion/kms_rotation_summary.md`, `/shared/sales-orion/byok_support_note.txt`

oliver_security: Plain English: "Encryption keys are managed in an HSM-backed KMS with scheduled rotations. Private deployments support customer-managed keys (BYOK) through standard KMS APIs."

jana_ps: Filenames: `/shared/sales-orion/soc2_excerpt.pdf`, `/shared/sales-orion/dataflow_narrative.md`, `/shared/sales-orion/poc_screenshot.png`

maria_sales: Nice. Two small follow-ups: 1) please ensure any hostnames/usernames are redacted in the files, 2) include a short verification line for the screenshot (what it demonstrates).

dan_se: I'll redact and add a line: "Screenshot shows tenant-specific runtime dashboard filtered to Orion-demo tenant (no PII)."

oliver_security: Adding: "Rotation cadence: 90 days (automated), HSM-backed key storage; logs retained per retention policy."

jana_ps: Added a caption to the screenshot and sanitized timestamps.

maria_sales: Great — I'll compile and aim to send the assembled ZIP to Orion by EOD tomorrow. If anything slips, ping me here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
